code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import deque, Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x,grid[y][x]))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(comp)
    template=max(comps,key=len)
    minr=min(y for y,x,v in template); maxr=max(y for y,x,v in template)
    minc=min(x for y,x,v in template); maxc=max(x for y,x,v in template)
    ar=(minr+maxr)//2; ac=(minc+maxc)//2
    shape=[(y-ar,x-ac,v) for y,x,v in template]
    markers=[(y,x) for comp in comps if comp is not template and len(comp)==1 for y,x,v in comp]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in markers:
        for dy,dx,v in shape:
            y,x=r+dy,c+dx
            if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w: out[y][x]=v
    return out
'''
